name: Dori
author: infiniV
description: Turn an Android phone into a webcam and a second screen, over USB.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: the phone's camera as a real v4l2 webcam, and its screen mirrored here, both over adb.

schema.label: Webcam device
schema.description: The v4l2loopback node the camera is streamed into. Must match the video_nr set when the module is loaded.

schema.label: Back camera id
schema.description: Run `scrcpy --list-cameras` if the back and front buttons are swapped.

schema.label: Front camera rotation
schema.description: Some phones deliver the front sensor upside down. Set 180 if yours does.

schema.label: Blank the phone screen while mirroring
Hide the bar icon when no phone is attached
